title: Universal Concessive Clauses: bármennyire (... is) and akárhogyan (... is)

sections.title: Forming Concessive Indefinites with bár- and akár-
sections.content: Hungarian forms universal free-choice and concessive pronouns/adverbs by prefixing bár- or akár- to interrogative stems (ki -> bárki/akárki, hogyan -> bárhogyan/akárhogyan, mennyire -> bármennyire/akármennyire). When combined with the concessive particle is after the verb or adjective ('no matter how...'), they introduce a subordinate clause whose extreme condition fails to prevent the main clause from holding true.

sections.title: Position of the Particle 'is' and Preverb Inversion
sections.content: In a concessive clause headed by bármennyire or akárhogyan, the word immediately precedes the verb (or modified adjective/adverb) in the focus slot, and the particle is stands immediately after that focused element or verb: Bármennyire igyekezett is Bolyai Farkas... ('However hard Farkas Bolyai tried...'). If the verb has a separable preverb, it inverts behind the verb!

sections.title: Concessive Indefinite Patterns
rows: Bármennyire igyekezett is, nem találta a bizonyítást.
However hard he tried, he did not find the proof.
Akárhogyan próbálták is levezetni, mindig zsákutcába jutottak.
No matter how they tried to derive it, they always hit a dead end.
Bármilyen nehéz volt is a feladat, Bolyai nem hátrált meg.
However difficult the task was, Bolyai did not back down.

items.spanish: Bármennyire igyekezett is Bolyai Farkas, minden bizonyítási kísérlete zsákutcába jutott.
items.english: However hard Farkas Bolyai tried, every attempt at proof reached a dead end.

items.spanish: Akárhogyan próbálják is az ötödik posztulátumot a többiből levezetni, az független marad tőlük.
items.english: No matter how they try to derive the fifth postulate from the others, it remains independent of them.

items.spanish: Bármennyire fájt is Jánosnak Gauss válasza, az Appendix megváltoztatta a matematika történetét.
items.english: However much Gauss's reply hurt János, the Appendix changed the history of mathematics.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Place the concessive particle is right after the verb (Bármennyire igyekezett is) or right after the adjective (Bármilyen rövid volt is az értekezés).
